title: Interstate truck travel-time reliability index improves to 1.36 in FY 2025
summary: DOT reports a 1.36 Interstate Truck Travel Time Reliability index in FY 2025, better than the 1.40 target; lower values indicate greater reliability. Denominator: Interstate travel-time segments using the 95th-to-50th percentile truck travel-time ratio from National Performance Management Research Data Set probe observations, including roughly 700,000 freight vehicles.
